prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
blank_sentence: Looking back, many residents described the neighborhood association as the tenants' ______.

worlds.passage: Starting in 2019, the tenants of a large apartment complex spent two years in talks with its owner over rents and repairs. Their committee had formed on its own a year earlier, and its members, all working night shifts, could not attend daytime sessions. The association's director sat across the table from the owner at every session, made the offers and counteroffers, and reported each result to the committee afterward. Looking back, many residents described the neighborhood association as the tenants' ______.
worlds.explanation: The association's director made the offers across the table on the tenants' behalf, so the association was the tenants' "negotiator." "Organizer" fails because the committee had formed on its own. "Observer" fails because the director made the offers, and "mentor" fails because she did the bargaining herself and merely reported results, rather than preparing tenants to bargain.

organizer.quote: formed on its own a year earlier

observer.why: an active bargainer was not merely watching

mentor.quote: reported each result to the committee afterward
mentor.why: she informed the tenants after the fact instead of coaching them

worlds.passage: Starting in 2019, the tenants of a large apartment complex spent two years in talks with its owner over rents and repairs. Before 2019 most tenants knew only their next-door neighbors; the association's volunteers went door to door, booked the community room, and ran the first meetings, at which tenants elected three spokespeople. Those three conducted every session with the owner, while the volunteers, busy with another building by then, never attended. Looking back, many residents described the neighborhood association as the tenants' ______.
worlds.explanation: The association brought tenants who barely knew one another together and ran the meetings that chose their leaders, so it was the tenants' "organizer." "Negotiator" fails because the spokespeople conducted every session. "Observer" fails because the volunteers never attended, and "mentor" fails because they had moved on to another building rather than guiding the spokespeople.

mentor.quote: busy with another building by then
mentor.why: they were not guiding the spokespeople

worlds.passage: Starting in 2019, the tenants of a large apartment complex spent two years in talks with its owner over rents and repairs. Their committee had formed on its own a year earlier, and its chair conducted every session with the owner. The association's director sat at the side of the room through all of them, writing the minutes that both sides later relied on, and she and the chair never exchanged a word. Looking back, many residents described the neighborhood association as the tenants' ______.
worlds.explanation: The association's director attended and recorded every session without taking part, so the association was the tenants' "observer." "Negotiator" fails because the chair conducted every session. "Organizer" fails because the committee had formed on its own, and "mentor" fails because the director and the chair never exchanged a word.
